WITH movie_kind AS (
    SELECT kt.id
    FROM kind_type AS kt
    WHERE kt.kind = 'movie'
),
production_company AS (
    SELECT ct.id
    FROM company_type AS ct
    WHERE ct.kind = 'production companies'
),
info_types AS (
    SELECT it.id, it.info
    FROM info_type AS it
    WHERE it.info IN ('rating', 'release dates')
),
us_companies AS (
    SELECT cn.id, cn.name
    FROM company_name AS cn
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
),
movie_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN movie_kind AS mk ON mk.id = t.kind_id
),
production_movie_companies AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, mc.company_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN production_company AS pc ON pc.id = mc.company_type_id
),
rating_movie_info_idx AS (
    SELECT miidx.movie_id, miidx.info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS miidx
    WHERE miidx.info_type_id IN (
        SELECT it.id
        FROM info_types AS it
        WHERE it.info = 'rating'
    )
),
release_movie_info AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    WHERE mi.info_type_id IN (
        SELECT it.id
        FROM info_types AS it
        WHERE it.info = 'release dates'
    )
)
SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS producing_company,
       MIN(rmii.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie
FROM production_movie_companies AS pmc
JOIN movie_titles AS t ON t.id = pmc.movie_id
JOIN us_companies AS cn ON cn.id = pmc.company_id
JOIN rating_movie_info_idx AS rmii ON rmii.movie_id = t.id
JOIN release_movie_info AS rel ON rel.movie_id = t.id
